Picreel pop-up script delivered skimmer.

Target: Picreel (via pop-up script)
Repository: N/A
Date: 2019-01-01 to 2019-05-01 (120 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Script
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised third-party script
Motive: Financial gain
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Credential theft, Data theft
User Impact:
Domain: picreel.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: dependency

Synopsis

Picreel, a service for conversion tools such as exit pop-ups, had its hosted JavaScript compromised. Attackers modified the script served to customer sites and injected a credit card skimmer, turning a marketing widget into payment-card theft wherever clients embedded it.
